Central Excise Tariff Act, 1985; Sub-heading 4408.90/Central Excise B and Salt Act, 1944; Section 4/Central Excise Rules, 1944; Rules 9(1), 52A, C 173B, on the plywood manufactured by them-Benefit of ememption .
